tier_should.rationale: Novel, large-scale persuasion tournament on existential risks; uniquely compares superforecasters and experts and documents persistent disagreement. Methods seem careful with incentives and rich data, but causal mechanisms unclear and generalizability limited. Strong fit for top forecasting/decision science journals.

tier_will.rationale: Interdisciplinary and politically sensitive topic; limited convergence may read as null results. Without sharper identification or policy implications, A-journals unlikely. Well-suited to strong field outlets (International Journal of Forecasting, Risk Analysis, Judgment and Decision Making).
